nonBehavioral: Widens the two plan-eng-review boundary predicates' qid regex to also accept the optional ;signal=<key> hint suffix (#3442). Only a question carrying that suffix can change verdict, and only the changed question-tuning resolver asks for it; every case that runs a skill with that resolver owns its generated SKILL.md, which this change also edits, so those cases already start their own series. No other case's input or verdict can change.
